content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-72. - Validity of bonds.
content.summary:
The validity of bonds shall not be dependent on nor affected by the validity or the
               regularity of any proceedings relating to the acquisition or improvement, or acquisition
               and improvement, of any project for which the bonds are issued.
(Code 1981, § 27-73; Ord. No. 551…
